layman_headline: Market is ripping but everything's already extended — patience is the play right now.
layman_explanation: Bitcoin just surged 22% in a week and most altcoins have moved even more aggressively. Our existing XRP position is down about 6% after buying near a local top during last week's massive rally. The market mood is greedy at 74/100 and Bitcoin dominance remains high at 59%, which means altcoins face headwinds. Nearly every swing candidate has already made a 30-60% move in 7 days, making new entries risky at these levels.
layman_action: Hold the current XRP position since it hasn't hit the stop-loss and the broader trend is still bullish. Wait for a pullback or consolidation before adding new positions. Don't chase the rally.
expert_reasoning: All swing candidates show negative composite scores due to overextended 7-day moves (37-58%) combined with high BTC dominance at 59.1% suppressing alt performance. The Fear & Greed index at 74 is in Greed territory, historically a mixed signal per our track record (56% win rate). XRP is held at a -5.8% unrealized loss but remains above its $1.30 stop-loss, and the massive 47% weekly rally suggests the broader trend is intact despite short-term pullback. No RSI or MACD data is available for the candidates, making technical confirmation impossible. The prudent approach is to hold and wait for a consolidation or pullback before deploying additional capital. SOL is the strongest watchlist candidate given its record on-chain activity, but needs to pull back to $91 support for acceptable risk/reward.

Greed reading of 74 with most assets up 20-50% in a week suggests a short-term correction is likely
XRP position entered at $1.56 during peak momentum — if BTC corrects, XRP could test the $1.30 stop-loss quickly
watch_list: BTC price action around $80K psychological resistance — a rejection here could trigger a broader alt selloff
XRP holding above $1.40 support — if it breaks below, tighten mental stop toward $1.35
SOL pullback toward $91 as a potential entry zone with record transaction activity as fundamental backing

context_banner: Post-rally consolidation phase — the market needs to digest massive weekly gains before new high-conviction entries emerge.
